subject: swordfish
title: This Fish Has a Heater Built Into Its Head to Warm Its Eyes

scenes.text: This fish has a heater built into its head, and it points it at its eyes.
A swordfish hunts hundreds of meters down, in water as cold as 3 degrees Celsius.
Cold slows eyes down. So an organ beside them heats eye and brain up to 15 degrees above the water.
Warm eyes react faster to quick prey like squid.
Researchers found the warm eye can process motion more than ten times faster than a cold one.
In the dark, cold deep, nothing outruns a fish with warm eyes.

description:
A swordfish has a heater organ next to its eyes that warms its eyes and brain up to 15 degrees above the water.
Warm eyes process fast motion more than ten times quicker, a big edge in the cold deep.
Which animal superpower would you borrow? Tell us below.
first_comment: Swordfish heat their own eyes to hunt in the cold dark. What would you do with night-vision goggles built in?
